title: Structural Engineering
summary: Analysis and design of steel and RCC structures to Indian, American, and European codes.
heroPrompt: Engineer reviewing a STAAD.Pro structural analysis model on a large monitor beside printed GA drawings, industrial office, focused, photoreal, no logos.

benefits.description: Analysis and design to the exact code your project specifies, documented and traceable.

benefits.title: Optimised tonnage
benefits.description: Section optimisation that trims steel weight without compromising safety factors.

benefits.title: Independent checking
benefits.description: Every calculation and drawing passes a separate checker before issue.

benefits.title: Constructible outputs
benefits.description: Designs coordinated with detailing and site sequencing from day one.

process.title: Requirement study
process.description: We review the design basis, loads, codes, and interfaces with other disciplines.

process.title: Analysis & design

process.title: Issue & support

faqs.q: Which design codes do you work to?
faqs.a: AISC 360, Eurocode 3, IS 800, BS 5950, and AS/NZS — selected per your project's design basis.

faqs.q: Can you take over a partially completed design?
faqs.a: Yes. We regularly pick up mid-stream, review the existing basis, and continue without restarting.

faqs.q: Do you provide independent design checks?
faqs.a: Yes — third-party / independent checking of another consultant's design is a standalone service we offer.

seo.title: Structural Engineering Consultant — Steel & RCC Design

title: Steel Detailing
summary: Fabrication and erection drawings, connection design, and BOMs — 1000+ MT/month capacity.
heroPrompt: Close-up of a detailed Tekla Structures steel connection model on screen — bolts, plates, welds — with a fabrication drawing beside it, photoreal, industrial.
overview: Steel detailing is our core discipline. Using Tekla Structures, we produce accurate, fully coordinated fabrication and erection drawings that let your fabricator cut, drill, and weld with confidence — to Indian, American, and European detailing standards.
With capacity beyond 1000 MT per month and a dedicated checking team, we deliver large detailing packages on aggressive schedules while keeping RFIs and rework to a minimum.

benefits.title: 1000+ MT/month capacity

benefits.title: Multi-standard fluency
benefits.description: Detailing to AISC, BS, IS, and Eurocode conventions as your shop requires.

benefits.title: Fewer RFIs at site

benefits.title: Fabricator-ready data
benefits.description: CNC/DSTV, NC files, and BOMs that plug straight into the shop.

process.title: Issue & revisions

faqs.a: Over 1000 MT per month, scalable with dedicated teams for large or fast-track projects.

title: BIM
summary: Coordinated 3D models, clash detection, and constructible data across every discipline.
heroPrompt: Federated BIM model of an industrial plant in Navisworks showing structure, piping, and equipment colour-coded, clash markers visible, photoreal screen capture.
overview: We build federated, constructible BIM models that bring structural, piping, mechanical, and electrical disciplines into a single coordinated environment. Clash detection resolves interferences on screen — long before they cost money at site.
Beyond geometry, our models carry the data your project needs: quantities, materials, and status — supporting quantity take-offs, planning, and downstream fabrication.

benefits.title: Single source of truth
benefits.description: One federated model every discipline coordinates against.

benefits.title: Clash-free construction
benefits.description: Interferences resolved digitally, cutting site rework and RFIs.

benefits.title: Reliable quantities
benefits.description: Model-driven take-offs for planning and procurement.

benefits.title: Constructible detail
benefits.description: LOD suited to fabrication, not just visualisation.

process.title: BIM execution plan
process.description: Agree LOD, standards, coordinates, and a federation strategy.

process.title: Discipline modelling
process.description: Structure, piping, and equipment modelled to the agreed LOD.

process.title: Clash detection
process.description: Federated review in Navisworks; clashes logged and resolved.

process.title: Coordinated output
process.description: Constructible model and reports issued for detailing and construction.

faqs.q: What level of detail (LOD) do you model to?
faqs.a: Typically LOD 350–400 for constructible outputs; we agree the exact LOD in the BIM execution plan.

faqs.q: Can you coordinate models from multiple vendors?
faqs.a: Yes — we federate and clash-check models from different disciplines and vendors in Navisworks.

faqs.q: Do your BIM models feed steel detailing?
faqs.a: Yes, our Tekla structural models are constructible and flow directly into fabrication.

seo.title: Structural BIM Services — Clash Detection & Coordination
seo.description: Structural BIM services: federated 3D models, clash detection, and constructible data for EPC and industrial projects. Tekla and Navisworks led.
